# Hogarvex - Instalaciones, Reparaciones y Mantenimiento

> Professional home repair and maintenance services in Barcelona and Maresme, Spain.

## About

Hogarvex is a certified technical team with 20 years of experience providing plumbing, electrical, and repair services to homes in Barcelona and the Maresme region. We offer transparent pricing, fast response times (quote within 1 hour), and guaranteed work.

## Services

- **Plumbing**: Leak repairs, tap installation, pipe unblocking, water heater installation, bathroom renovation
- **Electrical**: Short circuit detection, light and socket installation, electrical panels, low voltage installations, electrical certificates
- **Repairs & Installations**: Air conditioning, furniture assembly, shutter and lock repairs, small renovations, preventive maintenance

## Service Area

Barcelona city and Maresme region (Tiana, Badalona, Premià de Mar, and surrounding areas)
